interview_questions.question: What is PSTN, PBX, gateway and trunk boundaries, and why does it matter in telecom, voice or collaboration engineering?
interview_questions.preferred_answer: The PSTN provides public calling and numbering; a PBX supplies enterprise call control and features; gateways translate media or signaling; trunks carry groups of calls between systems. Clear boundaries make ownership, routing and failure domains visible.
